candidates.tagline: Merged a rocket company, an AI company, and a Reebok logo
candidates.story: After SpaceX acquired xAI in February 2026, Elon Musk completed the full 'SpaceXAI' rebrand on July 6 — and the new logo immediately went viral for being nearly indistinguishable from the Reebok chevron, drawing mockery from designers worldwide who noted the $4-trillion AI empire had accidentally rebranded as a mid-tier sportswear company.
candidates.why_funny: A company consolidating the world's most expensive tech brands produced a logo that looks exactly like the one on a $40 gym bag.
candidates.alt: The new SpaceXAI wordmark logo shown alongside the classic Reebok chevron logo in a side-by-side comparison highlighting their near-identical visual design, as covered by Creative Bloq on July 7, 2026

candidates.tagline: Google's back-tap shortcut: works perfectly without a case
candidates.story: Google's 'Quick Tap' feature lets Pixel owners double-tap the back of their phone to trigger shortcuts, but a July 7, 2026 Pocket-lint investigation found the sensor cannot reliably detect taps through even a thin silicone case — meaning the feature is functionally useless for the overwhelming majority of users who protect their phones.
candidates.why_funny: Google engineered a time-saving shortcut for the imaginary Pixel owner who keeps their $1,000 phone naked, leaving everyone else to tap their way to absolutely nothing.
candidates.alt: Back view of a white Google Pixel smartphone showing the camera module and Google logo, the location of the Quick Tap gesture sensor that stops working when a phone case is applied
